pages.text: In $(thing)Curved$() mode, right-click to start a line: on a block face, a pipe face, an existing curved node or in the air. Right-click in the air to add points, and on a face or a node to finish. Sneak and right-click to finish in the air.

A ghost tube shows the curve; it turns red when it would be refused. The line costs pipes from the off hand, about one per block, and gives them back when broken.$(br2)Esc or the mode key drops a half-drawn line.
